[Verse 1]
[D]All the way from Waco
to WEHO with a
[Bm]rabbit on her chain

to tend bar with the
[Bm]static on her brain
[D]She's a little burner,
burner, gonna
[Bm]throw you to the flame
[D]Little ticking time bomb,
time bomb, gonna
[Bm]blow us all away

[Chorus]
[D]
[Bm]Take the time to
waste a moment
[D]
[Bm]Never ask to
be forgiven

[D]

with no kin, always
[Bm]running from the law
[D]Every other weekend,
the week ends with his
[Bm]back at her claw
[D]He's a live wire,
wired, shooting
[Bm]sparks in the night
[D]He’s a gun for a hire,
hired with a
[Bm]bead in his sights

waste a moment
